posts.title: The Art of Mindful Stitches: Why Crochet is the Antidote to Digital Overload
posts.excerpt: In a world of constant notifications and screens, the rhythmic cadence of loop, yarn over, and pull through offers a gentle reset for a busy mind.
content: In a world of constant notifications and screens, the rhythmic cadence of loop, yarn over, and pull through offers a gentle reset for a busy mind.
Crochet gives your hands something to do and your thoughts somewhere to rest. A few rounds each evening can become a small ritual that slows the day down.

posts.title: Mastering Amigurumi: Perfect Tension, Clean Decreases & The Invisible Join
posts.excerpt: Unlock the secrets of adorable handmade plushies! Discover how to weave seamless shapes, keep your stitches tight, and finish like a pro.
content: Great amigurumi starts with tight, even stitches. Use a hook one or two sizes smaller than the yarn label suggests so the stuffing never peeks through.
For clean shaping, work invisible decreases through the front loops only, and finish with an invisible join so the last round blends into the first.

posts.title: Thoughtful & Heartfelt: 10 Handmade Crochet Gifts for Every Occasion
posts.excerpt: Never-withering sunflower stems, custom initial keychains, and snug baby booties: our favourite crochet gifts that say more than a store-bought card.
content: A handmade gift carries hours of care. Flower bouquets never wilt, initial keychains feel personal, and tiny booties become keepsakes.
Pick something that fits the person: a bouquet for a birthday, a keychain for a new job, and soft booties for a new baby.

posts.title: Crocheting for Little Ones: Safety Guidelines, Hypoallergenic Fibers & Beyond
posts.excerpt: Discover the best certified baby-safe yarns, secure seam construction, and breathable stitches that keep tiny skin comfortable and safe.
content: Babies need soft, breathable, washable yarn. Look for certified cotton or hypoallergenic blends and avoid anything shedding or scratchy.
Keep stitches snug, weave in ends securely, and skip small detachable parts so every piece is safe for little hands and mouths.

posts.title: Choosing the Right Yarn: A Friendly Guide to Cotton, Acrylic & Chenille
posts.excerpt: Not all yarn behaves the same. Learn which fibre suits plushies, home decor and wearables, and how weight and texture change the final look.
content: Cotton is crisp and durable, great for doilies and coasters. Acrylic is light and budget friendly, and chenille makes velvety, huggable toys.
Match the fibre to the finished piece, and always make a small swatch before you commit to a whole project.

posts.title: Meet the Maker: A Day in the CozyLoops Studio
posts.excerpt: From the first cup of tea to the final stitch, take a peek at how every CozyLoops creation is planned, crocheted and packed with love.
content: Mornings start with tea, sketches and a look at the order list. Each piece is crocheted by hand, one loop at a time.
Before anything ships it is checked, steamed and wrapped with a handwritten thank-you note.

posts.title: Styling Handmade Decor: Cozy Corners with Crochet Doilies and Blooms
posts.excerpt: Turn any shelf, table or windowsill into a warm little corner using crochet doilies, flower stems and soft textures.
content: Start with a statement piece, like a bold doily under a vase, then layer softer textures around it.
Repeat one colour across two or three items, and leave space between them so each handmade detail can shine.

posts.title: Caring for Your Crochet: Washing, Storing & Keeping It Soft for Years
posts.excerpt: A little care goes a long way. Learn how to wash, dry and store your handmade pieces so they stay soft, shaped and beautiful.
content: Hand wash in cool water with a gentle soap, press out the water without wringing, and dry flat away from direct sun.
Store pieces in a breathable cotton bag, never a sealed plastic one, and refresh them with a light steam before gifting.
